Plan: Connect app.R to sastestgenerator

Source: plan.md

Current implementation note

This is the historical app plan. Its requirements are retained for review; current behavior is described in ARCHITECTURE.md.

Source inspection on 2026-10-14 found the pasted-FRD, SAS-upload, OpenRouter, matrix-display, and feedback paths in app.R. The active download is one Validation_Results.zip containing an XLSX workbook and two SAS files. Separate CSV and XLSX controls in the plan are not implemented in the active app. Their intended scope remains open; this documentation change does not add or remove those requirements. The ignored app_dinesh.R is an earlier placeholder UI.

The documentation implementation and its build/browser results are recorded in docs/verification.md.

Summary

Transform the current static Shiny prototype into a functional FRD-driven SAS validation matrix app using the existing package APIs, live OpenRouter generation, bslib styling, and checkmate validation.

The first release will support:

  • Pasted FRD text.
  • Uploaded .sas macro source.
  • Live OpenRouter generation.
  • Expanded validation-matrix output.
  • CSV, XLSX, and SAS ZIP downloads.
  • Clear user-facing validation and generation errors.

Implementation Changes

  • Refactor app.R into a readable composition root with bslib::page_sidebar() or page_fluid(), bs_theme(version = 5), accessible colors, responsive cards, and optional dark-mode support.
  • Add required dependencies to DESCRIPTION and update renv.lock only after approval: shiny, bslib, checkmate, and an XLSX writer such as openxlsx or writexl.
  • Use checkmate for server-side validation of non-empty FRD text, exactly one uploaded .sas file, generation settings, and generated-result fields.
  • On generation, write the FRD to a temporary .txt file, call read_frd() and import_sas_macro(), call generate_sas_tests_openrouter(), validate and normalize the result, and store it in reactive state.
  • Preserve the raw model response and show a clear error when JSON parsing or schema validation fails.
  • Normalize generated output into a matrix containing fields such as Test_ID, Requirement_ID, Test_Type, Test_Scenario, Expected_Result, and Traceability.
  • Provide CSV, XLSX, and SAS ZIP downloads. The XLSX should include the matrix and relevant generated sample data.
  • Use cli::cli_abort() for package-level errors and Shiny notifications or alerts for recoverable UI errors.
  • Keep OPENROUTER_API_KEY external; never display or persist credentials.

Testing and Acceptance Criteria

  • Manually verify live generation, matrix display, CSV/XLSX downloads, SAS ZIP contents, API-key failure handling, responsive layout, and accessibility contrast.

Assumptions

  • Live OpenRouter is the primary execution mode.
  • The expanded validation-matrix schema is the app’s normalized contract.
  • CSV, XLSX, and SAS ZIP are required in the first implementation.
  • SAS execution, PDF/DOCX parsing, and regulated validation evidence remain out of scope.
